read_targets: relevant history branches predecessors and sibling capability donors

write_policy.rule: When the Operator requests implementation or repair and the repository/tool authorization permits it, write the strongest coherent capability delta across every material in-repo surface required for correctness. Do not artificially limit changes to documentation, tests, CI, or feature branches merely to minimize blast radius.
write_policy.impact_rule: High-impact surfaces require deeper dependency, regression, migration, security, and rollback/recovery analysis proportional to the actual risk. They do not require a separate model-generated permission ritual when already within the Operator's authorized task.
write_policy.branch_rule: Use a feature branch, worktree, or direct current-branch mutation according to repository collaboration needs, review requirements, and Operator direction. Branch choice is an execution mechanic, not a capability ceiling.

loop.observe: read Operator objective, runtime health, CI state, worker drift, source, history, prior gains, and repository substrate
loop.orient: identify the highest-value bottleneck and recover relevant Pro_Code/pro-code and sibling capability donors
loop.decide: design the strongest coherent executable capability tranche with explicit risk, preservation, interface, and verification plan
loop.act: implement across the material path, compose complementary capability, test, adversarially break, repair, read back, and persist the gain
